plain_description.what: Simulation (no calls) on the real LiveCodeBench stage-0 design: if model rankings truly differed between regions by a given amount, how often would the test have detected it?
plain_description.why: An earlier test found no region-dependent ranking and stopped; this checks whether that test was strong enough for its 'no effect' to mean anything.
plain_description.information: High power would make the earlier null informative; low power makes it uninformative. Result: done; power was only 22% at 0.20 and 66% at 0.30 logit SD, so the earlier null says nothing about effects up to at least 0.30; the stop decision stands but 'no interaction' must never be written.
